locations.quote: In and out. Fifteen minutes. Nobody gets hurt.
locations.quoteContext: Harry Flynn pitching the Museum Heist to Nate
locations.spatialNote: Moonlit museum stealth infiltration across Ottoman domes and ancient sewers.

locations.quote: Good news is we found Marco Polo's lost fleet. Bad news is Lazarevic found it first.
locations.quoteContext: Nate and Chloe inspecting the expedition camp
locations.spatialNote: Jungle firefights among moss-covered tidal swamps and ancient ship hulks.

locations.quote: Well, look on the bright side. We don't have to pay for a hotel room.
locations.quoteContext: Nate and Elena taking cover in a Nepalese alleyway
locations.spatialNote: Vertical traversal across street barricades, hotel collapses, and pagodas.

locations.quote: There's a guy above you! ...There's a bear above you!
locations.quoteContext: Tenzin leading Nate through ice caves
locations.spatialNote: Cliffside train derailment hanging over a 2,000-foot vertical drop.

locations.tagline: Tree of Life & Overgrown Ancient Valley
locations.quote: The Cintamani Stone isn't a sapphire. It's petrified tree resin from the Tree of Life.
locations.quoteContext: Nate uncovering the truth inside the Golden Sanctuary
locations.spatialNote: Mythical lost city hidden behind ice cliffs with glowing blue resin pools.
